data.gender_notes: Jedediah is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew name Yedidya (יְדִידְיָה) which means 'friend of Jehovah' or 'Jehovah knows'. In the Old Testament, Jedediah is a name given to several individuals, including a descendant of David and a friend of Job. The name Jedediah carries the meaning “God knows, friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. data.cultural_impact: Jedediah is a name with a rich history, and its popularity is not limited to just Christianity. In ancient times, it was a name given to individuals who held a deep connection with their deity or God. The name has been passed down through generations, starting with the Hebrews and later adopted by Christians. The name carried a sense of trust, courage, and loyalty, and it was believed that a person with this name would be favored by God. In Christian culture, the name Jedediah is a reminder of the strong spiritual bond between God and his followers.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jedediah holds a deep spiritual significance for Christians. It serves as a reminder that God is not just a creator or an observer but also a friend who is always there to guide, protect, and support his people. The name Jedediah reflects the Christian belief that God is intimately involved in our lives and that He knows us better than anyone else. It also symbolizes the desire to be a friend of God, to have a deep and personal relationship with Him, and to live our lives in a way that pleases Him. The name Jedediah encourages us to live our lives with trust, courage, and loyalty to God, knowing that He is always with us and that He loves us unconditionally.
